title: Governor of Odisha meets Prime Minister
body_text:
Governor of Odisha, Dr. Hari Babu Kambhampati met Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi today in New Delhi.
In a post on X, the Prime Minister’s Office said;
“Governor of Odisha, @DrHariBabuK met Prime Minister @narendramodi.
@GovernorOdisha”
Governor of Odisha, @DrHariBabuK met Prime Minister @narendramodi . @GovernorOdisha pic.twitter.com/JAqnKlCENY — PMO India (@PMOIndia) October 1, 2026
